title: Does On-Policy Distillation Need to Complete Every Rollout?
abstract: arXiv:2610.21337v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) effectively transfers capabilities from a teacher to a student through feedback on student-generated rollouts. However, generating complete student rollouts and computing teacher feedback for every token make OPD computationally expensive. We introduce Stochastic Truncated On-Policy Distillation (STOPD), which accelerates OPD by randomly truncating student rollouts and correcting the resulting sampling bias with blockwise inverse-probability weighting (IPW). At each training step, we sample a stopping position for each rollout before generation and let the student generate until that position or natural termination. We obtain teacher feedback on every generated token and use blockwise IPW to compensate for the lower probability of retaining later tokens while controlling the weights. We prove that this weighting preserves Vanilla OPD's gradient sum in expectation and derive one-step update-error bounds for

translated_title: 在策略蒸馏需要完成每一次 Rollout 吗？
translated_abstract: 在策略蒸馏（On-policy Distillation, OPD）通过对学生模型生成的 rollout 序列提供反馈，有效地将教师模型的能力迁移给学生模型。然而，生成完整的学生 rollout 序列并为每个 token 计算教师反馈，使得 OPD 的计算开销十分高昂。我们提出了随机截断在策略蒸馏（Stochastic Truncated On-Policy Distillation, STOPD），该方法通过随机截断学生 rollout 序列，并利用分块逆概率加权（blockwise IPW）校正由此产生的采样偏差，从而加速 OPD。在每一步训练中，我们在生成前为每个 rollout 采样一个停止位置，让学生模型生成至该位置或自然终止。我们对每个生成的 token 获取教师反馈，并使用分块 IPW 补偿保留后续 token 的较低概率，同时对权重加以控制。我们证明了这种加权方式在期望意义上保持了原始 OPD 的梯度总和不变，并推导出了一步更新的误差界……
tldr: 该论文提出随机截断在策略蒸馏（STOPD），通过在生成前随机采样停止位置来截断学生的 rollout 序列，并用分块逆概率加权校正采样偏差，在期望意义上保持与原始 OPD 相同的梯度，从而大幅降低计算开销。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Stochastic Truncated On-Policy Distillation (STOPD), which accelerates on-policy distillation by randomly truncating student rollouts before generation and correcting the sampling bias with blockwise inverse-probability weighting, provably preserving the expected gradient of vanilla OPD.
